name: Hungry Smoke Trap (CR 8)
body:
Hungry Smoke Trap
CR 8

XP 4,800

Source: Pathfinder #9

Type magical Perception DC 30 Disable Device DC 30

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset repair

Effect When the glass case is damaged or opening or disabling the lock is attempted with anything other than its proper key, two belkers are summoned into the room. The belkers remain summoned for 2 minutes, after which time they vanish.
